title: Tar Leviathan
description: A wide gritty reese bass built from a detuned sawtooth swarm: layered off-copies drift apart in pitch while pan LFOs smear the swarm across the stereo field. Over 32 cycles it climbs from a subterranean growl through a full-spectrum register as the ladder filter, fm grit and detune width all morph on prime-numbered clocks.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 <c2 eb1>>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .detune(sine.slow(23).range(0.1, 0.45))
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1.5, 6)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/8")
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 3400)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 3 5>/8").lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<3 5>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.05, 0.3))
    .shape(0.4).crush("<16 12 8>/16")
    .attack(0.006).decay(0.2).sustain(0.7).release(0.08)
    .off(0.005, x => x.add(note(0.12)).pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.05, 0.45)).gain(0.7))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(-0.12)).pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.55, 0.95)).gain(0.7))
    .jux(rev)
    .room(0.2).delay("0.3:0.5:0.6")
    .gain(0.85)
)
